title: A treat for you, too
headline: A treat for you, too
caption:
Sweets for the trick-or-treaters, and something kind for you. 🎃

After a busy Saturday on your feet, try this before bed:

Lie on your back and hug both knees into your chest. Let your shoulders soften into the floor, then rock slowly from side to side for about a minute. Breathe out long and easy.

It's a lovely, gentle way to ease a tired lower back, and it's the kind of calm, simple movement we love in our Stretch and Mat Pilates classes here in Clitheroe.

Save this for tonight, once the doorbell finally stops ringing.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
